shortDescription: SNMP Policy configuration for Cisco Intersight

options.name: access_community_string
options.description: The default SNMPv1, SNMPv2c community name or SNMPv3 username to include on any trap messages sent to the SNMP host. The name can be 32 characters long. Used with SNMPv2c access only.

options.name: api_bearer_token
options.description: Bearer token for OAuth2 authentication with the Intersight API. When provided, I(api_key_id) and I(api_private_key) are not required and the C(cryptography) Python library is not needed. If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_BEARER_TOKEN environment variable is used.

options.name: api_key_id
options.description: Public API Key ID associated with the private key. If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_KEY_ID environment variable is used. Required if I(api_bearer_token) is not provided.

options.name: api_private_key
options.description: Filename (absolute path) or string of PEM formatted private key data to be used for Intersight API authentication. If a string is used, Ansible vault should be used to encrypt string data. Ex. ansible-vault encrypt_string --vault-id tme@/Users/dsoper/Documents/vault_password_file '-----BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY-----     <your private key data>     -----END EC PRIVATE KEY-----' If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_PRIVATE_KEY environment variable is used. Required if I(api_bearer_token) is not

options.name: api_uri
options.description: URI used to access the Intersight API. If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_URI environment variable is used.

options.name: community_access
options.description: Controls access to the information in the inventory tables. Applicable only for SNMPv2c users. For SNMPv3, this is always set to C(Disabled). For SNMPv2c, valid choices are C(Disabled), C(Limited), and C(Full). Required when C(enabled) is C(true).

options.name: description
options.description: The user-defined description for the SNMP Policy. Description can contain letters(a-z, A-Z), numbers(0-9), hyphen(-), period(.), colon(:), or an underscore(_).

options.name: enabled
options.description: State of the SNMP Policy on the endpoint. If enabled, the endpoint sends SNMP traps to the designated host.

options.name: engine_input_id
options.description: User-defined unique identification of the static engine. Used with SNMPv3 only.

options.name: name
options.description: The name assigned to the SNMP Policy. The name must be between 1 and 64 alphanumeric characters, allowing special characters :-_.

options.name: organization
options.description: The name of the Organization this resource is assigned to. Profiles, Policies, and Pools that are created within a Custom Organization are applicable only to devices in the same Organization.

options.name: snmp_port
options.description: Port on which Cisco IMC SNMP agent runs. Enter a value between 1-65535. Reserved ports not allowed (22, 23, 80, 123, 389, 443, 623, 636, 2068, 3268, 3269).

options.name: snmp_traps
options.description: List of SNMP trap destinations.

options.name: snmp_users
options.description: List of SNMP users for SNMPv3 authentication.

options.name: state
options.description: If C(present), will verify the resource is present and will create if needed. If C(absent), will verify the resource is absent and will delete if needed.

options.name: sys_contact
options.description: Contact person responsible for the SNMP implementation. Enter a string up to 64 characters, such as an email address or a name and telephone number. Required when C(enabled) is C(true).

options.name: sys_location
options.description: Location of the host on which the SNMP agent (server) runs. Required when C(enabled) is C(true).

options.name: tags
options.description: List of tags in Key:<user-defined key> Value:<user-defined value> format.

options.name: trap_community
options.description: SNMP community group used for sending SNMP trap to other devices. Valid only for SNMPv2c users.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts.

options.name: v2c_enabled
options.description: State of the SNMPv2c protocol. When enabled, SNMPv2c access is available for the associated servers.

options.name: v3_enabled
options.description: State of the SNMPv3 protocol. When enabled, SNMPv3 access is available for the associated servers.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean control for verifying the api_uri TLS certificate
